page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 8 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system includes 16.0 GB of memory, delivering a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM balance with 2.0 GB allocated per core. The server does not bundle local disk storage, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for operational file storage and operating system images.

Network connectivity is provisioned with a 6 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance does not include integrated GPU hardware, concentrating its system capacity purely on central processor throughput. The lack of local physical disks shifts all input and output operations to network interfaces, presenting an architectural tradeoff between remote disk latency and stateless deployment flexibility.

In terms of resource allocation, the compact 1:2 memory ratio offers economic efficiency by minimizing spend on unused RAM for tasks centered around processor utilization. Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.2xlarge is suitable for compute-bound workloads operating with modest data footprints, such as CI/CD compilation runners, web serving tiers, API gateways, microservices, and batch compute jobs.
